newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon budget deficit 44.6 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon budget deficit 44.6 pct in May.

text.p: Lebanon's monthly budget deficit was 44.6 percent in May and the deficit for the first five months of the year was 56.3 percent, according to finance ministry statistics released on Monday.
This compared with an April deficit of government income to expenditure of 62.06 percent and a deficit for the first four months of the year of 60.3 percent.
The deficit target for the year under the 1997 budget law approved by parliament in January is 36 percent.
